basics.type: Private university (Amity University Punjab), the eleventh university set up by the not-for-profit Amity Foundation
basics.campus: 40-acre campus in Mohali, about 10 minutes from Chandigarh International Airport
basics.other: 90+ undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, plus doctoral programmes; law programmes approved by the Bar Council of India

admission: Class 12 with 50% overall and 50% in PCM
Valid NATA score of the current year
Class 12 with 60%, and 70% in Maths or Economics
Class 12; minimum marks differ by programme (often 50–60%)

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships for Class 12 (2025 or 2026) students: 100% for 95% and above and 50% for 90–94.99% from CBSE or ISC; 30% for state-board students with 90% and above. Sports and defence scholarships are also offered. Scholarships are limited and given first come, first served.

hostel.text: Hostel rooms are allotted on request; details come with the admission letter.

fees.text: Amity sends the fees for all semesters in each student's admission letter. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
